run_image_to_text_pipeline: run an image-to-text generation pipeline on HPU using a vision-language model like LLaVA or PaliGemma
run_distributed_inference: run distributed image-to-text inference across multiple HPUs using DeepSpeed tensor parallelism
run_fp8_quantization: run FP8 quantization on a vision-language model using neural compressor for HPU inference
run_benchmark_pipeline: run a benchmark of the image-to-text pipeline measuring throughput and HPU memory usage
